outcome: Trends in severe postpartum hemorrhage rates
cohort: All hospital deliveries in Canada (excluding Quebec) from 2003 to 2010 (n=2,193,425)
finding: Rates of both postpartum hemorrhage and severe postpartum hemorrhage continued to increase in Canada between 2003 and 2010, and these increases could not be explained by changes in maternal, fetal, or obstetric factors.
